name: timeOffsetDeployment
description: Time offset value at deployment in number of microseconds

name: timeOffsetRetrieval
description: Time offset value at retrieval in number of microseconds

name: timedriftCorrected
description: Set to 1 if time drift correction applied or 0 if not.

name: correctionMethod
description: Method for time drift correction. 0 is uncorrected. 1 is linear correction. FF other correction method.

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be set to 43 (hex) or 67 (decimal) for Time Drift Header.
